lessons.correction: Focus on increasing your economy and expansion while continuing technology development. Strengthen ground forces as a baseline and maintain a defensive posture.
lessons.mistake: Committing to a large army before knowing the enemy's plan, which can leave you vulnerable to tech switches or economic deficits.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate once you have more scouting information about the opponent's army composition.
lessons.title: Avoid premature army investment
lessons.when: Early game, around 180 seconds, when both players have unknown army postures but heavy technology investment, and your production is moderate while the opponent's is heavy.
lessons.why: With the opponent's army unknown, building a solid economy and tech base allows flexibility to adapt to whatever the opponent reveals.

lessons.correction: Increase defensive capabilities while continuing to strengthen ground forces. Maintain economy and expansion, and consider adding siege tanks to your composition.
lessons.mistake: Being too passive, allowing the opponent to gain an economic advantage, or engaging without proper siege setup.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the opponent attempts to break your defensive line or transitions to air.
lessons.title: Avoid passivity and unsieged engagements
lessons.when: Midgame, around 420-540 seconds, when both players have ground-oriented macro postures with heavy production and technology, and the opponent shows siege tanks and marines.
lessons.why: With both sides having heavy ground armies, a defensive posture with siege tanks helps hold position while teching and expanding, outlasting the opponent in a macro game.

lessons.correction: Continue strengthening ground forces while adding air support or anti-air capabilities to counter medivacs. Maintain defensive posture and economy.
lessons.mistake: Neglecting air defense, leaving you vulnerable to Medivac drops and healing.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the opponent commits heavily to air or if defensive positioning needs adjustment.
lessons.title: Avoid neglecting air defense
lessons.when: Late midgame, around 600 seconds, when both players have ground-oriented macro postures with heavy production and technology, and the opponent has medivacs while your air presence is light.
lessons.why: The opponent's medivacs provide mobility and healing, so adding air units or anti-air helps deal with drops and sustain in engagements.
